## Advanced Case: The Four State Model on The Complete Phylogeny

Let's load some useful libraries and some simulated data for 100 sites.
<style>
    img {
        border: 0;
    }
</style>
```{r load_lib_object}
library(ape)
library(data.table)
library(memento)

data("object_phased")
str(object_phased)
```

And a bit of data cleaning. As before, the tree must be rescaled so that branch lengths are number of SNVs.

```{r clean}
df_meta <- object_phased$meta
filters <- object_phased$filter.param
dt_annotation <- data.table(object_phased$details)
dt_annotation[, chr_pos := paste0(Chrom, "_", Pos)]
setkey(dt_annotation, chr_pos)

tree <- object_phased$tree
tree$tip.label <- gsub("PD40521_Normal_EM1_", "", tree$tip.label)

mtx_list <- object_phased[object_phased$EXTRAFIELDS]

chr_pos_object <- paste0(object_phased$details$Chrom, "_", object_phased$details$Pos)

for(i in 1:length(mtx_list)){
   rownames(mtx_list[[i]]) <- chr_pos_object
   colnames(mtx_list[[i]]) <- tree$tip.label
}

range(tree$edge.length)

tree$edge.length <- tree$edge.length*20
tree_di <- tree
tree <- di2multi(tree) # convert to polytomy
tree
```
Update settings to four states.

```{r settings}
settings <- memento_settings()
settings
set_memento_settings(new_number_of_states = 4)
new_settings <- memento_settings()
new_settings
```
Find changes on full tree.

```{r find_changes_full}
priors_phased <- generate_priors(full_tree = tree, 
                                 m = 2)
# find changes
assignments_phased_full <- compute_probabilities(priors_per_tree = priors_phased,
                                                 matrix_list = mtx_list,
                                                 n_top_br = 2,
                                                 ro = 0.95, 
                                                 verbose = TRUE)
head(assignments_phased_full, 10)

```

Plot changes. The reads at each site will now be plotted as a trio of maternal, paternal and unphased reads.

```{r hm_full, out.width="700px", out.height="700px", dpi = 300, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
rate_mtx_list <- list("MT_rate" = mtx_list$MT_M/(mtx_list$MT_M + mtx_list$MT_U),
                      "PT_rate" = mtx_list$PT_M/(mtx_list$PT_M + mtx_list$PT_U),
                      "U_rate" = mtx_list$U_M/(mtx_list$U_M + mtx_list$U_U))

assignments_phased_best <- assignments_phased_full[rank == 1,]

some_phased_assignments <- c("58.4:15", "2_33.3:9_10", "27_50.1:3_2",
                             "1_45.3:10_10", "7_32.1:3_3", "1_45.3:9_10")

for(i in 1:length(some_phased_assignments)){
  hm_plot_phased <- plot_heatmap(assignment = some_phased_assignments[i],
                          full_dt = assignments_phased_best,
                          meth_rate_mtx = rate_mtx_list,
                          tree = tree)
  plot(hm_plot_phased)
}

```

## Advanced Case: Splitting the Phylogeny

As in the three state model, we split the tree and assign changes. 

```{r four_state_split}
subtrees <- divide_tree_into_subtrees(full_tree = tree, max_subtree_size = 12)

# compute priors
priors_p_subtree_phased <- generate_priors(all_trees = subtrees, 
                                           full_tree = tree)

# find changes on each subtree
assignments_split_phased <- lapply(priors_p_subtree_phased,
                                   compute_probabilities, 
                                   matrix_list = mtx_list,
                                   ro = 0.95, 
                                   verbose = TRUE)
head(assignments_split_phased[[1]])
# find candidate changes on the full tree
converted_dt_phased <- convert_sub_to_full_tree_branches(assignments = assignments_split_phased,
                                                  subtrees = subtrees,
                                                  full_tree = tree)
head(converted_dt_phased)

mle_branch_dt_phased <- find_most_likely_set(dt_pre =  converted_dt_phased,
                                             full_tree = tree,
                                             ro = 0.95,
                                             n_top_br = 2,
                                             mtx_list = mtx_list,
                                             fraction_estimate = 1,
                                             verbose = FALSE,
                                             dt_anno = dt_annotation)
head(mle_branch_dt_phased)
```

Plot changes on the phylogeny.

```{r plot_phased_four, out.width="700px", out.height="700px", dpi = 300, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
mle_dt_best_phased <- mle_branch_dt_phased[rank == 1,]
same_sites_as_before <- assignments_phased_best[branch %in% some_phased_assignments][["chr_pos"]] # filter to plotted positions
mle_subset_phased <- mle_dt_best_phased[chr_pos %in% same_sites_as_before]
mle_subset_phased[, .(probability, branch, only_branch, starting_state, branch_state, n_assignments_mle)]

same_sites_new_assignment <- names(sort(table(mle_subset_phased[["branch"]]), decreasing = TRUE))

for(i in 1:length(same_sites_new_assignment)){
  hm_plot_phased_split <- plot_heatmap(assignment = same_sites_new_assignment[i],
                       full_dt = mle_subset_phased,
                       meth_rate_mtx = rate_mtx_list,
                       tree = tree)
  plot(hm_plot_phased_split)
}

```
